summary: Copy Subset from Standard Cost Code List
description: Copy a subset of Cost Codes from Standard Cost Code List.

201.description: All of the Standard Cost Codes in the subset were copied successfully

successes.description: Array of successfully created Cost Codes

207.description: Only part of the Standard Cost Codes subset was copied successfully

standard_cost_code_list_id.description: ID of the standard cost code list to copy codes from. Must be a list belonging to the same company as the project.

standard_cost_code_ids.description: IDs of the specific standard cost codes to copy. Must include the ancestors of any standard cost code in this list so the hierarchy is preserved.

sub_job_id.description: ID of the sub job to copy cost codes into. When provided, codes are copied to the sub job rather than the project directly.

project_id.description: ID of the project to copy cost codes into.
